note: Private RV park along the Shell Rock River SE of Mason City; RV Life campers in 2024 and 2026 call it mostly long-term. Rates by phone. Cabin and camper rentals; no tent sites. Heated pool, playground. Rail bridge near the entrance is about 13 ft 3 in per campers: call for directions. --Claude
summary: Hookups and year-round confirmed; no rate posted. Riverfront stands; pin fine. CRITERIA FLAG: long-stay in character with no posted nightly rate, test 2 fails; reported price sits on the $50 line.
flags: CRITERIA, RECOMMEND DROP (mostly seasonal/long-term, on the fence = drop): TEST 2 fails: own site says only 'Contact us for monthly, weekly and nightly rates', no nightly figure, no booking engine for RV sites (Airbnb/Vrbo are its cabins and in-town apartments), and an RV Life $$ tier doesn't stand in. LONG-STAY EVIDENCE: RV Life reviewers 'Mostly long term campground' (11/2024) and 'Mostly semi permanent campsites' (8/2026); imagery shows nearly every pad along the river filled with rigs (well over 45, RV Life's site count), though the frame's date and season aren't known. Monthly and weekly sold alongside nightly. AGAINST: nights are really sold by phone with no application or minimum in any report (overnighters in 7/2025, 11/2024, 9/2026); no homes or lots for sale; well reviewed. No traveller-site count anywhere (test 4 no count = pass).

GATE FACTS: PRICE: no posted rate. RV Life reviewers paid $50 (9/2026), $50 (8/2026), $45 (2/2026), $55 (7/2025), $50 (11/2024), so right on the $50 gate; avg_rate $38, $$. Camper figures not written to fees because the operator has a web page. GATEWAY: none within 40 km (St. Paul 194 km). GOOD SAM: not a GS Park (no Iowa directory entry by this name). PRESENCE: working site, phones 641-696-3413, call/text 641-512-1307. RATINGS: Google 4.8 / 340; RV Life 9.52/10 from 13 ratings. Campspot, Campendium and The Dyrt not read.

WATERFRONT: riverfront stands. Channel about 30-38 m at the sites (0.29 m/px), right at the riverfront/creekside line; river-row rigs about 10-20 m from the bank with their lane on the land side. Note: wooded strip on the bank, a pond on the west side is separate.
ACCESS: 13 ft 3 in rail bridge passes EKKO (under 10.5 ft); note carries it for directions. Google's route may send rigs under it.
PIN: Google 43.2137,-93.0935 is about 90 m from stored; fine.
